criteria.text: Notes that NF-kB activation is the step the ranking turns on.

grounding.quote: NF-kB activation is the step that drives the proliferative response

criteria.text: Puts IL-1beta and TNF-alpha in one tie set because the premises give them equal NF-kB activation at the doses used.

grounding.quote: IL-1beta and TNF-alpha activate NF-kB to the same degree at the doses used

criteria.text: Ranks TGF-beta last because it arrests the cell cycle rather than driving proliferation.

grounding.quote: TGF-beta drives the cells into a myofibroblast state and arrests the cell cycle

criteria.text: Places IL-6 between the NF-kB cytokines and TGF-beta on its roughly half-size STAT3-driven effect.

grounding.quote: raises EdU incorporation about half as much as NF-kB activation does
